title: Accept current-v19 five-column native AOI footprints in fast full-world scans

scope.trigger: User-reported server-2212 Truck, Train and Secret Task scans stopping at 98% with 'The action could not be completed.'

liveFailure.runError: direct map scan contains failed batches
liveFailure.sourceError: Fast full-world adaptive acquisition returned a non-rectangular v18 AOI footprint
liveFailure.interpretation: The rejected footprint is actually a complete rectangular 10-row by 5-contiguous-column native footprint (10*5=50 AOIs).

persistedLastSuccessfulProbe.meaning: The type-specific probe remained healthy at the far map edge; the terminal failure was the host adaptive-footprint validator, not a Dispatch normalization failure.

rootCause.why98Percent: The direct scan persisted 2499 completed logical blocks and one failed block after the adaptive sweep rejected a valid live footprint.

implementation.coverageRequirement: still exactly 10,000 LOD0 AOIs before publication

test.name: FastFullMapAcceptsFiveColumnFootprint
test.fixture: 10 rows x 5 contiguous columns at a current-v19-shaped interior footprint

impact.truckTrainSecretTask: The identified validator defect is shared by Truck/Railway/Dispatch fast full-world sweeps. Deterministic regression is fixed; fresh live scans are still required before claiming each user-visible mode live-proven.
impact.monster: Monster-only uses the separate whole-world LOD2 path and is not fixed or changed by this checkpoint.
